## Data Analysis
```{r}
sm_header_function <- function(x, rep_val){
  
  orig <- x
  
  sv <- x
  sv <- sv[1,]
  sv <- sv[, sapply(sv, Negate(anyNA)), drop = FALSE]
  sv <- t(sv)
  sv <- cbind(rownames(sv), data.frame(sv, row.names = NULL))
  names(sv)[1] <- "name"
  names(sv)[2] <- "value"
  sv$grp <- with(sv, ave(name, FUN = function(x) cumsum(!startsWith(name, rep_val))))
  sv$new_value <- with(sv, ave(name, grp, FUN = function(x) head(x, 1)))
  sv$new_value <- paste0(sv$new_value, " ", sv$value)
  new_names <- as.character(sv$new_value)
  colnames(orig)[which(colnames(orig) %in% sv$name)] <- sv$new_value
  orig <- orig[-c(1),]
  return(orig)
}

```


```{r}
mod1<- read.csv("CSV/Customer Survey 2025 English Online.csv")

mod2<- read.csv("CSV/Customer Survey 2025 English Online.csv")

sm_header_function <- function(x, rep_val){
  
  orig <- x
  
  sv <- x
  sv <- sv[1,]
  sv <- sv[, sapply(sv, Negate(anyNA)), drop = FALSE]
  sv <- t(sv)
  sv <- cbind(rownames(sv), data.frame(sv, row.names = NULL))
  names(sv)[1] <- "name"
  names(sv)[2] <- "value"
  sv$grp <- with(sv, ave(name, FUN = function(x) cumsum(!startsWith(name, rep_val))))
  sv$new_value <- with(sv, ave(name, grp, FUN = function(x) head(x, 1)))
  sv$new_value <- paste0(sv$new_value, " ", sv$value)
  new_names <- as.character(sv$new_value)
  colnames(orig)[which(colnames(orig) %in% sv$name)] <- sv$new_value
  orig <- orig[-c(1),]
  return(orig)
}

mod3<-sm_header_function(mod2, "X")
```

```{r}
mod3_renamed <- mod3 %>%

              .cols = starts_with("we_invite_you_to_get_involved_with_prepare_and_prosper_check_the_box_for_the_opportunity_opportunities_you_are_interested_in")) %>%

  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^if_you_are_not_already_a_volunteer_what_barriers_if_any_prevent_you_from_volunteering_with_prepare_prosper_", "volunteer_barrier_"),
              .cols = starts_with("if_you_are_not_already_a_volunteer_what_barriers_if_any_prevent_you_from_volunteering_with_prepare_prosper"))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 🤝 Step 2: Define and Apply Consolidation Function (Robust Fix for NAs/Warnings)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# This version explicitly handles non-numeric data (like "" or text) and NAs
# to avoid the "NAs introduced by coercion" warning and the resulting empty strings.
combine_multiselect_final_v5 <- function(data, prefix) {
  
  # 1. Identify the full names of all columns for this prefix group
  prefix_cols <- names(data)[starts_with(prefix, vars = names(data))]
  
  if (length(prefix_cols) == 0) {
    message(paste("No columns found for prefix:", prefix, ". Skipping."))
    return(data)
  }

  # 2. Use a concise selection and combination within the mutate call
  data_combined <- data %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Define the new combined column name
      !!paste0(prefix, "_combined") := {
        # Select the column values for the current row
        current_values <- c_across(all_of(prefix_cols))
        
        # --- KEY FIX FOR NA WARNINGS ---
        # 1. Coerce values to numeric, treating NA and non-numeric (like "") as NA.
        numeric_values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(current_values))
        
        # 2. Identify the position (index) of the columns where the value is 1
        is_selected <- !is.na(numeric_values) & numeric_values == 1
        
        # 3. Look up the actual column names (answer choices) using the index
        selected_choices <- prefix_cols[is_selected]
        
        # 4. Collapse the selected choices into a single string
        if(length(selected_choices) == 0) {
            # If nothing was selected for the row, return an empty string, not NA.
            "" 
        } else {
            paste(selected_choices, collapse = "; ")
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Remove the original, individual-answer columns, preserving all other columns
    select(-all_of(prefix_cols))
  
  return(data_combined)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 🚀 Step 3: Full Consolidation Pipeline Execution
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Apply the consolidation function sequentially to all multi-select blocks
mod3_final <- mod3_renamed %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("app_schedule") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("tax_service_rank") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("tax_info_source") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("race") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("sexual_identity") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("lang_speak") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("disability") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("fin_challenge") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("goal") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("ctc_info") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("ctc_use") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("involvement") %>%
  combine_multiselect_final_v5("volunteer_barrier")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## ✅ Verification and Final Data Check
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- Sample of Consolidated Race Data (Should contain choices now) ---\n")
mod3_final$race_combined %>% head(10) %>% print()

cat("\n--- Final Column Count Check ---\n")
print(length(names(mod3_final)))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Assuming your raw data frame is named 'mod3'
mod3_working <- mod3 

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 🤝 Step 1: Define Column Lists (Using original names)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

race_cols <- c(
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. American Indian or Alaska Native",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. African",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Black or African American",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Asian or Asian American",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. White or European Descent",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Middle Eastern or North African",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Hispanic or Latino/e",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Prefer not to answer",
    "How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify. Another race"
)

sex_id_cols <- c(
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Straight/Heterosexual",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Gay/Lesbian",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Bisexual",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Pansexual",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Queer",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Unsure",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. Prefer not to answer",
    "How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer. If you wish to self-describe please do so here"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 🚀 Step 2: Execute Brute-Force Consolidation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

mod3_combined_brute <- mod3_working %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    
    # 1. Race Consolidation
    mutate(
        race_combined_brute = {
            # Select the values from the current row
            current_values <- c_across(all_of(race_cols))
            
            # --- BRUTE-FORCE CHECK: TRUE if the cell value is NOT NA ---
            is_selected <- !is.na(current_values)
            
            # Get column names where a value exists
            selected_choices <- race_cols[which(is_selected)]
            
            # Clean and combine (The cleaning step is necessary for readable output)
            if(length(selected_choices) == 0) {
                "" 
            } else {
                # Clean up the long column name text
                cleaned_choices <- str_remove(selected_choices, fixed("How.do.you.identify...select.all.that.apply.or.self.identify."))
                cleaned_choices <- str_trim(cleaned_choices, side = "left")
                paste(cleaned_choices, collapse = "; ")
            }
        },
        
        # 2. Sexual Identity Consolidation
        sexual_identity_combined_brute = {
            # Select the values from the current row
            current_values <- c_across(all_of(sex_id_cols))
            
            # --- BRUTE-FORCE CHECK: TRUE if the cell value is NOT NA ---
            is_selected <- !is.na(current_values)
            
            # Get column names where a value exists
            selected_choices <- sex_id_cols[which(is_selected)]
            
            # Clean and combine
            if(length(selected_choices) == 0) {
                "" 
            } else {
                # Clean up the long column name text
                cleaned_choices <- str_remove(selected_choices, fixed("How.do.you.currently.describe.your.sexual.identity.Please.select.the.option.that.best.fits.how.you.identify..You.may.skip.this.question.if.you.prefer.not.to.answer."))
                cleaned_choices <- str_trim(cleaned_choices, side = "left")
                paste(cleaned_choices, collapse = "; ")
            }
        }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() # Do NOT remove original columns here, so you can inspect them.


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## ✅ Verification and Debugging Step
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- Sample of Consolidated Race Data (Checking for Content) ---\n")
mod3_combined_brute$race_combined_brute %>% head(10) %>% print()

cat("\n--- Sample of Consolidated Sexual Identity Data (Checking for Content) ---\n")
mod3_combined_brute$sexual_identity_combined_brute %>% head(10) %>% print()
```
